observations.text: Long pond washes left pale horizontal windows.
Crossing washes reduced windows; early close screenshot framing was partial.
Broad overlapping shell masses stayed filled without interior slits; silhouette remained faceted. Full canvas framing corrected.
Sampled neck joined shell continuously; central close view cut off head.
Unequal sparse scute seams read as broad plates.
Rightward pan revealed a blue slit in the lower head.
Two olive overlaps closed the head slit and preserved the dark eye.
Translucent water veils quieted bright pond windows.
New wood grain crossed rear foot and weakened its edge.
Rear foot restoration made it read again; low watercolor contact avoided a raised oil rail.
Loaded warm shell planes read more strongly than earlier thin lights, but made separate patches.
Reed seed head floated over a faint stem.
Narrow connector restored reed continuity; neighboring olive reduced shell patch isolation.
One compact eye glint stayed tiny in whole view and visible in rightward close view.
Matching neighbors eased neck-root color contrast but added raised light patch.
Log neighbors quieted bright rear-foot crossing; claws stayed small.

Final neighboring olive softened shoulder/scute color joins while retaining relief. Whole/close and head pan retained filled shell, continuous neck, touching feet, quiet reeds and one eye glint; faceted edge and regular bristles remain. More covers unlikely to help.

framing: Early framing at 4 and 8 excluded part of close canvas; 8 whole clip was offset and 12 whole cropped a small top margin. Framing corrected at 16 and subsequent 26 pairs show full whole canvas and displayed settled 2.0× close view. Central close views exclude head; additional rightward pans at 40,44,48,95,96,112 inspect it. Camera click at 4 timed out during painting, recovered after idle. A drag at 40 was refused in close mode and added no mark. Browser storage reported full/unavailable; actual PNG and complete JSON preserved by chunked portable export. Regular bristles, raised joins and faceted shell edge remain.
